# prep environment and load data
```{r}
# clear workspace
rm(list=ls())

# load in packages
pacman::p_load(dplyr, ggplot2, tidyr) #stringr,psych, tidyr)

# load in files
files <- Sys.glob("~/Documents/umn_work/topx_analyses/topx_clean/clean_data/all/*.csv") # all data
```

# create 
```{r}
#open empty dataframe
agg_dat <- data.frame()
agg_dat_abbrev<- data.frame()

# load data into new dataframe
# for testing, without for-loop, run 'filename = files[1]'
filename = files[1]
#for (filename in files) {

# read in data
dat <- read.csv(filename)

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    rt_cue_stim   = if_else(response_state == "cue", response_time, NA_real_),
    rt_probe_stim = if_else(response_state == "probe", response_time, NA_real_),

    cue_duration   = if_else(response_state == "cue", duration, NA_real_),
    probe_duration = if_else(response_state == "probe", duration, NA_real_),

    lagged_cue_duration   = lag(cue_duration),
    lagged_probe_duration = lag(probe_duration),

    rt_cue_focus   = if_else(response_state == "cue_focus", 
                             response_time + lagged_cue_duration, NA_real_),
    rt_probe_focus = if_else(response_state == "probe_focus", 
                             response_time + lagged_probe_duration, NA_real_),

    rt_cue   = coalesce(rt_cue_stim, rt_cue_focus),
    rt_probe = coalesce(rt_probe_stim, rt_probe_focus)) %>%
  select(-cue_duration, -probe_duration, -lagged_cue_duration, -lagged_probe_duration,
         -start_time, -end_time, -duration, -response_time, -response,
         -blocksCompleted, -trialsCompleted, -cue_image, -probe_image)

dat_abbrev <- dat %>%
  select(subj, visit, rt_cue, rt_probe) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(rt_cue) & is.na(rt_probe)))

dat_abbrev <- dat_abbrev %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(rt_cue, rt_probe),
    names_to = "state",
    values_to = "rt"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    state = if_else(state == "rt_cue", "cue", "probe")
  )  %>%
  filter(!is.na(rt))

# write rows from this for-loop to previous aggregate data from
agg_dat <- bind_rows(agg_dat, dat)
agg_dat_abbrev <- bind_rows(agg_dat_abbrev, dat_abbrev)

}
```


```{r}

# Density plots with semi-transparent fill
ggplot(dat_abbrev, aes(x=rt, fill=state)) + geom_density(alpha=.3)

```
